title: Quality Metric
description: One quality metric computed for a recording, with exactly one producer: the plugin or the recipe that computed it. Plugin manifests (nemar-cli shared/contract) declare each metric output with this shape.

value.description: The metric's value; null when it could not be computed.

unit.description: Unit of the value (for example %, dB, count).

description.description: One-sentence description of what the metric measures.

bounds.description: The valid range the producer declares for this value (for example 0 to 100 for a percentage), not a quality threshold and not the range observed across recordings (that is the dataset summary's observed_range).

plugin.description: The plugin that produced this value; exactly one of plugin and recipe.

recipe.description: The recipe that produced this value; exactly one of plugin and recipe.
